scope.spec_text_is_authority: The clause text above is quoted from the Master Spec. Where this contract and the spec differ, the spec wins and this contract is regenerated.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: The enumeration accepts the member `footage` with the exact meaning the spec states: An audio/video layer whose source is an imported media item. Carries the full transform, effects, masks and time properties.. No member is added, renamed, or silently mapped onto another.

The enumeration accepts the member `composition` with the exact meaning the spec states: An audio/video layer whose source is another `StudioComposition` (a precomposition).. No member is added, renamed, or silently mapped onto another.

The enumeration accepts the member `solid` with the exact meaning the spec states: A single-colour layer of a declared size. The workhorse carrier for effects that generate rather than filter.. No member is added, renamed, or silently mapped onto another.

The enumeration accepts the member `text` with the exact meaning the spec states: A text layer with a source-text property, path options, more options and an animator collection ([STU-MOT-090]).. No member is added, renamed, or silently mapped onto another.

The enumeration accepts the member `shape` with the exact meaning the spec states: A procedurally-defined vector layer built from shape operators ([STU-MOT-100]).. No member is added, renamed, or silently mapped onto another.

The enumeration accepts the member `camera` with the exact meaning the spec states: A camera. Renders nothing; defines the view for 3D layers ([STU-CMP-040]).. No member is added, renamed, or silently mapped onto another.

The enumeration accepts the member `light` with the exact meaning the spec states: A light. Renders nothing; illuminates 3D layers ([STU-CMP-045]).. No member is added, renamed, or silently mapped onto another.

The enumeration accepts the member `null` with the exact meaning the spec states: An invisible zero-content layer used purely as a parent or an expression target ([STU-MOT-008]).. No member is added, renamed, or silently mapped onto another.

The enumeration accepts the member `adjustment` with the exact meaning the spec states: A layer whose effects apply to everything composited beneath it in the stack rather than to its own content ([STU-CMP-015]).. No member is added, renamed, or silently mapped onto another.

The enumeration accepts the member `guide` with the exact meaning the spec states: A layer visible while authoring and excluded from render by default ([STU-MOT-121]).. No member is added, renamed, or silently mapped onto another.

implementation_notes.naming: Vendor product names are provenance only. Studio ships Handshake-native names per [STU-SECTION-003].
implementation_notes.database: SurrealDB with the EventLedger is the only durable authority. SQLite, libSQL, Turso and PostgreSQL are forbidden, including in tests and dev caches.
implementation_notes.engine_split: GPU, WGSL and compute live in the studio-engine crate behind its traits. handshake_core must never gain a GPU dependency.
implementation_notes.routing: Navigation extends the existing address and bus seams. No new router.

validator_focus: Confirm every acceptance row traces to a sentence or table row in the cited spec clause. A row with no spec basis is a fabrication and fails the contract.
Reject scaffold-only proof: at least one proof command must drive the executable runtime rather than a fixture the implementer authored.
For a parameter row, confirm hard and soft bounds are stored as separate values and an unknown bound is stored as unknown rather than mirrored from its opposite.
